subject: Clarify GCP Marketplace logo usage and 24/7 support hours for AcmeCloud listing
messages:
From: gcp-partner-onboarding@acmecloud.io
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP listing - logo usage and support hours

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. We have two asks before we push the listing live to GCP Marketplace: 1) confirmation on acceptable logo variants and size/clearspace for the marketplace tile; 2) how Redwood's 24/7 support claim should be represented in the listing copy and support window matrix.

Attached is our current logo pack (acme_logo_pack_v2.zip) and a draft support hours spreadsheet. Specific questions: 
- Can we include the horizontal and monochrome logos, or do you require the full-color mark only?
- GCP requires explicit support hours per region; can Redwood confirm a canonical statement for US/EU/APAC with UTC offsets?
- Is it acceptable to say "24/7 global support with regional SLA routing" or do we need a more prescriptive line referencing response times?

We'd like to finalize this by EOD Wednesday so the marketing team can finish the tile.

Thanks,
Sara Chen
Partnerships, AcmeCloud Inc.

Attachments: acme_logo_pack_v2.zip (images), proposed_support_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: logan_wright@redwood.ai
To: gcp-partner-onboarding@acmecloud.io
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 May 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP listing - logo usage and support hours

Sara — thanks for laying this out. Quick answers up front, details below:

- Logo: horizontal and monochrome variants are fine for the marketplace tile, but we need vector SVGs and a 1:1 square mark for small-fallback sizes. Please include clearspace measurements in the asset PSD or a short readme.
- Support copy: avoid using "24/7" without follow-on specifics. For marketplace copy we recommend: "24/7 global support (regional routing; initial response within 4 hours for Sev 1 incidents)". That gives a measurable expectation while allowing routing notes.
- Region hours: we'll provide canonical UTC offsets for our routing matrix. We've historically used PST/UTC offsets in the US block — happy to map to GCP's required fields.

Action items:
1) Sara: send final SVGs and a one-slide logo guidance doc (clearspace + do/don't).
2) Connor: will draft the exact UI-friendly listing copy and confirm the wording is acceptable to legal.
3) Kimberly: can you confirm the 4-hour response for Sev 1 across Dedicated customers or propose alternate wording if that's inaccurate?

If we can get the assets and a thumbs on the copy by Wed EOD (PST) we should be able to hit your marketing deadline.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Looping back after checking with Ops and Legal — short answer: the proposed phrasing is ok with caveats. Details below.

Legal/Brand:
- Accept full-color, horizontal, and single-color marks. Required: SVG + 1:1 PNG at 512px and 128px. Add a readme.txt in the asset zip with clearspace numbers. No animated marks.

Support/SRE:
- "Initial response within 4 hours for Sev 1" is acceptable for Hosted/Hosted Plus tiers. For Dedicated customers we commit "Initial response within 1 hour for Sev 1".
- Recommend we expose a supported-tier matrix in the listing details page and keep the general listing copy to: "24/7 global support (initial response SLA varies by plan; see support matrix)". That avoids overpromising in the tile.

Formatting suggestion for marketplace tile (short):
- Title line: Redwood Inference — High-performance LLM inference
- Subtitle (one-liner): Production-grade inference, predictable latency and cost
- Support line: "24/7 global support — see plan-specific SLAs"

Connor, please draft the short and medium-length copy blocks and attach the matrix table.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Product Ops Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Sara and team,

Thanks for the submission. A few policy notes from Marketplace ops: 
- Logo assets: SVG + 512x512 PNG required. PNG must be square; we will crop non-square tiles. Avoid microtext or color gradients for small sizes.
- Support claims: Marketplace policy requires either (A) explicit hours in UTC, or (B) a link to a public support policy page with the same detail. If you use the matrix approach, please host the matrix at a stable URL and provide the drive link at publication.
- Short copy length limits: tile subtitle maximum 140 chars; support line must be <= 100 chars.

Recommended final support short line for tile (<=100 chars): "24/7 global support — plan-specific response SLAs at example.com/support"

We can accept the file set Kimberly described. Please update the Drive link to the final assets and submit the revised listing in the portal by next Mon to avoid queue delays.

Best,
Harish Rao
Marketplace Operations | Google Cloud
